parent_objective: audit materialized current-sim checkpoint/profile panel before measured execution design
blocked_by: M2171 result must be audited before real measured execution command design
supersedes: direct measured execution immediately after checkpoint materialization

public_gates: M2172 must audit M2171 summary and profile checkpoint rows
M2172 must confirm all 320 materialized workload checkpoint paths exist
M2172 must confirm L3_reset_control aliases L3_online_gru and did not train separately
M2172 must not run measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run real M2151 measured execution
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the materialized checkpoint/workload panel is admissible for later measured-execution command design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: materialization audit only; no measured execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if any checkpoint path is missing or nonexistent
stop if reset-control alias policy is violated
stop if materialized workload loses M2151 metadata
stop if audit would route directly to measured execution without command design
fallback_plan: route to checkpoint materialization repair if audit fails
route to measured execution command design if audit passes
route to synthesis if the current-sim branch reaches cadence before execution

admission_evidence: M2171 writes profile checkpoint rows and materialized workload
allowed_updates: M2172 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured execution command design or materialization repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2172 audits materialized checkpoints and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2172.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the materialization output is invalid, route to repair and do not compare controllers.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits newly materialized checkpoint/workload panel before measured execution design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit measured execution command design but cannot decide controller comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2172 cannot classify the M2171 output

hypothesis: The M2171 materialized checkpoint/profile panel is clean enough to admit a measured-execution command design, while keeping ranking and paper claims blocked.
success_criteria: all 320 materialized workload checkpoint paths are confirmed existing
no measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: any checkpoint path is missing or nonexistent
reset-control trained separately or does not alias L3_online_gru
decision_rule: M2172 passes if it audits M2171 as clean materialization evidence and explicitly routes to measured execution command design without running it.
